meta.name: readout
meta.description: Prepare a sponsor update separating promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance. Use for progress readouts or defending a delivery claim.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把承诺产出、实测结果与客户验收分栏写清,交出一份站得住脚的进度汇报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要向赞助方或高层说明项目进展,并回应交付成果的质疑
copy.tagline_en: Draft a sponsor update that separates promises, measured results and customer sign-off
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must report project progress to a sponsor or exec and defend delivery claims

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你准备面向赞助方的进展汇报,把「承诺的成果」「实测结果」「客户验收」三部分分开陈述。也可用来为一项交付声明做辩护。
howto.when: 当你需要准备进度汇报,或需要为某项交付声明辩护时触发。若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前的脱敏包和范围,不重跑已答过的设置与提问。

say.text: 帮我把这次迭代的承诺成果和实测结果分开,做一份给赞助方的汇报
say.note: 产出分成承诺与实测的进展更新

say.text: 客户还没签字验收,帮我按承诺、实测、验收三段写进展
say.note: 未知项会保留,不替你补全

say.text: 有人质疑这个交付,帮我按承诺和实测结果整理辩护材料
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude prepares a sponsor update that separates promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance. It can also be used to defend a delivery claim.
howto.when_en: Use it when preparing a progress readout or defending a delivery claim. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or already-answered questions.

say_en.text: Separate the promised outcomes and measured results from this iteration into a sponsor update
say_en.note: Outputs a readout split into promise and measurement

say_en.text: The customer hasn't signed off yet; write the update as promised, measured, acceptance
say_en.note: Unknowns are preserved, not filled in

say_en.text: Someone is challenging this delivery; assemble the promised versus measured evidence
say_en.note: Keeps implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance distinct
